description: This file defines the 'Inspector' class which is responsible for analyzing and processing Android bug reports. It includes methods for extracting process and thread information, identifying ANRs, associating logs with processes/threads, detecting deadlocks, and marking logcat regions during ANRs or bugreport capture. The class acts as the core logic for interpreting bug report data to facilitate troubleshooting and diagnostics.

classes.name: Inspector
classes.description: Main class responsible for analyzing Android bug reports, extracting process and thread info, detecting ANRs, deadlocks, and marking log regions relevant to bugs.

methods.name: inspect
methods.description: Entry point to perform comprehensive inspection of the provided bug report.

methods.name: makeProcessInfo
methods.description: Populate process and thread information from various data sources within the bug report.

methods.name: findAnr
methods.description: Detects and sets the last known ANR (Application Not Responding) in the bug report from logcat logs.

methods.name: inspectProcesses
methods.description: Performs analysis on process snapshots, such as lock combination, thread marking, and deadlock detection.

methods.name: combineLocks
methods.description: Aggregates lock information across stack frames for each thread.

methods.name: markBinderThreads
methods.description: Identifies threads involved in binder transactions.

methods.name: markBlockedThreads
methods.description: Flags threads that are blocked on locks.

methods.name: markInterestingThreads
methods.description: Tags threads as interesting based on certain criteria.

methods.name: inventLogcatTimes
methods.description: Fills in missing timestamps in logcat lines.

methods.name: mergeLogcat
methods.description: Combines system and event logs into a single chronological log.

methods.name: makeInterestingLogcat
methods.description: Identifies and marks log lines that are relevant or noteworthy.

methods.name: markLogcatProcessesAndThreads
methods.description: Associates log lines with process and thread metadata.

methods.name: markAnrLogcatRegions
methods.description: Marks logcat lines that indicate the start of an ANR event.

methods.name: markAnrRegion
methods.description: Marks log lines occurring during an ANR period.

methods.name: markBugreportRegions
methods.description: Tags log lines that occurred during the bug report capture window.

methods.name: trimLogcat
methods.description: Reduces logcat display to a manageable timeframe around bug report start.
